newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania slams Italy over sinking of refugee boat.
newsitem.headline: Albania slams Italy over sinking of refugee boat.

text.p: Albania, angry over the sinking of a refugee boat in the Adriatic, told Italy on Saturday that the accident could have been avoided and that the guilty should be revealed.

"I appreciate Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi's statement and I ask his cabinet to start investigations so that the guilty be identified. I still insist the tragedy should have been avoided," Albanian Prime Minister Bashkim Fino said on television.
Albanian Deputy Foreign Minister Pavllo Zeri summoned the Italian ambassador, Paolo Foresti. Zeri told him the Italian government must take steps to prevent such tragedies in future.
Parliamentary speaker Pjeter Arbnori strongly criticised Italy's handling of the incident, saying: "The boat should have been accompanied to Italy's coast instead of being blocked."

At least four people died when an illegal Albanian refugee boat sank after colliding with an Italian navy corvette. The Italian navy has been turning back Albanian refugees fleeing by boat across the Adriatic to escape unrest in their country.
